scope: Assigned frozen titles and complete ItemBodies, local rendered HTML, capture receipts, and all assigned screenshot tiles. Local files only; no live routes.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully; SCHEMA.md and WORKFLOW.md read for repository and rendering-audit context.
review_method.rendering: Every assigned local PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution; no collage or downscaling.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: Each assigned title and full ItemBody was reviewed across the complete snapshot line range and compared with the assigned local source and HTML; receipts and tile hashes were checked.
review_method.boundary: Read-only review. No production items, application files, publication/status metadata, or native state edited. No tests, builds, gates, commits, pushes, or network calls. Only lane-04.md and lane-04.json written.

findings.symptom: The technique sentence includes raw TeX delimiters and commands (for example `$x^2-5y^2=\pm1$`, `\pm`, subscripts, and `$\varepsilon$`); the HTML/screenshot prints these literally instead of typesetting them.
findings.suggested_repair: Rewrite the Proof technique value as plain prose without TeX delimiters or TeX commands, e.g. identify the units by solving the norm equations for the Pell order and maximal order, then compare their cyclic groups using ε as a common generator.
